notes.title: Demo QoL Patch
notes.content:
This patch is meant to add a few features which seem highly desired. Some small balance issues were also tweaked.

[list]
[*]Added context menu (accessed by right-clicking items in inventory.) Includes: unload, consume, remove attachments, and drop.
[*]Items can be consumed from the inventory (it kicks you out of inventory, for now.)
[*]All weapons can be unloaded in inventory via the context menu.
[*]Added key rebinding in Settings (escape menu.)
[*]Title menu and settings menu should scale better with screen size.
[*]Slowed enemy reaction time by 25%.
[*]Enemies take longer to raise their weapons
[*]Tweaked ironsights of Sitka to be more usable without a scope (may adjust more later.)
[*]Added sprite to the auto shotgun.
[*]Slightly improved the harvestable plant hitboxes.
[*]Reduced instances where the interaction text will stay on the screen when it's not supposed to.
[/list]
